description: This file defines a React functional component called `ComponentView` that renders an iframe-based view for a web component, manages its loading state, handles various feature states, errors, and external interactions such as subscriptions and keyboard events.

methods.name: manageSubscription
methods.description: Calls the function to open the subscription dashboard for the application.

methods.name: reloadValidityStatus
methods.description: Updates feature status, validation, error messages, and deprecation info based on current component viewer state.

methods.name: dismissDeprecationMessage
methods.description: Dismisses the deprecation message displayed to the user.

methods.name: onVisibilityChange
methods.description: Handles visibility change events for the document, triggering reload if issues loading.

methods.name: onIframeLoad
methods.description: Handles the iframe load event; sets the content window, updates loading state, and triggers the onLoad callback.
